description.narrative: Increased access to affordable and improved electricity and generation capacity from RE

This indicator is linked to Photovoltaic Mainstreaming (PVM) component of the project. PVM is rural electrification activity, installing solar home systems (SHS) within the coverage areas of the participating ECs.

comment.narrative: 2853 units of SHS were installed under Window 1 which was completed by the end of September 2019 and 17852 units have been installed under Window 2.
